title: Quaint Egyptian Falafel Pilaf
description: A flavorful Egyptian dish featuring falafel, pilaf, and a hint of mustard, perfect for a brunch mood, served in a bento box with a side of jam and tempering chocolate, made with ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the falafel mix according to the package instructions.
Cook the pilaf rice with 4 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of salt until fluffy.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and add the mustard seeds, letting them temper for a few seconds.
Add the cooked falafel to the pan and stir well.
Combine the cooked pilaf rice with the falafel mixture and stir gently.
Melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Assemble the dish in a bento box with a side of jam and tempering chocolate.
